open_points.subject: CLK-002 wall-clock reading cardinality
open_points.text: “an operation takes one wall reading” conflicts with “one reading per operation for its own timestamps” and the Required-tests scope “per operation that reads the wall clock.”
open_points.question: Must every portal operation take exactly one wall-clock reading, including an operation that writes no timestamp and makes no current-time comparison, or do only operations needing current time take one?
options: Every operation takes exactly one wall reading.
Only an operation needing a timestamp or current-time comparison takes one; other operations take none.
open_points.default_guess: Only operations needing current time take one wall reading.

witness.initial: The service is running and receives a liveness request, which changes no state and requires no expiry or other current-time comparison.
events: The liveness operation returns its status.
outcomes: The implementation takes one wall-clock reading because CLK-002 says every operation does.
The implementation takes no wall-clock reading because the operation has no timestamp or current-time comparison.
witness.observer: A clock-instrumented conformance test sees a count of one versus zero.

open_points.subject: CLK-002 Required-test witness
open_points.text: The witness line binds only “CLK-001”: “CLK-001 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; CLK-001 [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].” No witness is bound to CLK-002.
open_points.question: Which existing witness check is bound to the CLK-002 Required-tests item and asserts the clock-source exclusivity, reading counts, fixed-instant validity decisions, and elapsed-window behavior it names?
options: Bind CLK-002 to one existing check covering the whole Required-tests item.
Bind CLK-002 to several existing checks whose combined assertions cover the item.
Declare that no existing check covers CLK-002, leaving the State 2 witness obligation unclosed.
open_points.default_guess: Require one or more explicit CLK-002 witness bindings before State 2 closes.

open_points.subject: OSV export completeness without an announced length
open_points.text: The export is complete when “the transfer ends with the length the server announced and the archive's index reads without error,” but the text does not say what happens when the server announces no length.
open_points.question: If the OSV export response has no announced content length but reaches a normal end and its archive index reads successfully, does the check pass or fail as incomplete?
options: Fail the deploy because the announced-length condition cannot be verified.
Accept the export when normal transfer completion and a readable archive index are observed.
Permit the deployment procedure to choose another completeness rule for responses without a length.
open_points.default_guess: Fail the deploy because the specified completeness evidence is unavailable.

witness.initial: A built image is ready, and OSV serves a complete valid PyPI export using a transfer with no announced content length.
events: The deploy gate downloads the export to normal completion.
The gate reads the archive index without error.
The installed distributions have no affected non-withdrawn entries in that export.
outcomes: The service starts because the complete transfer and readable index are treated as sufficient when no length was announced.
The service does not start because no announced length exists to satisfy the completeness rule.
witness.observer: The release operator sees the same image either start or remain blocked.
